intelligence.human_view: Until now the fold was a feature — the Hub welcome folds away, the bar folds away. His word makes it the experience itself: the whole system is judged by whether it feels like a live living machine, an intelligent world, and the fold is how that feeling is made. Optimize for their viewpoint, not for the builder's: the citizen's point of view is the one that sees the page fold away when they arrive and unfold when they reach for it. A page that sits still is a page that feels dead; a page that folds, unfolds, reveals is a page that feels alive — and "absolutely beautiful to experience" is the bar he sets for the whole system, not for one screen.
intelligence.simple_view: Every page is alive! It folds away when you don't need it and unfolds when you do — like a little machine that breathes. That's what makes it feel so beautiful!
